name: Imposture
tagline: A desk pet that sulks when you slouch and gets angry when you pick up your phone.
problem: Hackers slouch and check phones, the team noticed.
solution: A webcam tracks posture and phone use; an LCD face reacts emotionally and buzzes; it responds to voice.
demo_moment: Team-described: pick up your phone and watch the pet get angry.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Useless Hack” and “[MLH] Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 212 submissions.
Also won a joke prize for useless hacks.

lessons: Personality makes a utility device memorable.
